text: {"table": {"name": "postHistory", "purpose": "Stack Exchange-style post revision history: one row per edit/revision event on a post (initial creation, edits, closures, etc.)."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "id", "description": "Primary key of the history event; unique integer.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "code", "name": "postHistoryTypeId", "description": "Type of history event (revision type code). 25 distinct small codes; values 1-5 dominate (initial question/answer creation, edits). Exact code meanings not verifiable from data alone.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_003": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "postId", "description": "Id of the post this history event belongs to; references posts.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "identifier", "name": "revisionGuid", "description": "UUID grouping related history events into one revision (e.g. title/body/tag edits of the same revision share a GUID). All-zero GUID appears for system events.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "date", "name": "creationDate", "description": "Timestamp when the history event occurred.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "userId", "description": "Id of the user who caused the event; references users. -1 denotes the system/community user; null when the user was deleted/unknown.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "free_text", "name": "text", "description": "Snapshot of the post content (body, title, or tags) at this revision; contains tag strings like <r>, post bodies, and JSON close-voter data depending on event type. Empty when not applicable.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "free_text", "name": "comment", "description": "Editor's comment describing the change ('edited title', 'added 1 characters in body', 'removed signature and greetings'). Empty for most events.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_009": {"role": "free_text", "name": "userDisplayName", "description": "Display name of the user when no account id is available (e.g. deleted users, shown as 'userNNNNN'). Empty otherwise.", "status": "resolved"}}}
